product.name: Servo Gear Set for 2000 Series 'Torque' Servo (V3.0)

warnings: No dimensions were scraped or stated. The estimate assumes the set fits a standard-size servo case of about 40 x 20 x 37 mm, as in the servo photos, so the largest gear is roughly 38-40 mm in diameter. The compound gear stack height is assumed to be about 16 mm. The 4 mm bore is assumed from the small shaft and bushing proportions. Tooth counts and module are not given and were not inferred. The hole is a single representative bore at the gear center. The other gears, shafts and bushings are not modeled individually, and no mounting pattern is visible.
Dimensions are unverified estimates. The listing gives no sizes, so the bounds come from the image analysis.
Tooth counts, module, and the gear and pinion thicknesses are assumed. Teeth are simple trapezoids, not true involute profiles.
Only the largest gear is modeled. The other three gears, the pressed-in bearing, the two steel shafts and the two bronze bushings are omitted.
The 4 mm bore is an assumed value, with no bearing or bushing detail.
The gear axis is along Z as in the analysis, so the Y=0 bottom rule puts the gear center at Y=20.
